red.reason: The new empty-existing-validation cases initially returned unchanged and had no repairable suggestion or metadata scope.

repairRouting.repairableStatus: Source-backed empty validation metadata is reported as repairable while the original action remains unchanged.
repairRouting.feedback: The bounded repair input carries candidate validation metadata, validation.cases as the missing field, operation/evidence diagnostics, original intent and local file scope.
repairRouting.existingRejectedRepair: Existing concrete program failures still use the same repair and dependency/shared-file rollback behavior.
repairRouting.noBasis: An empty declaration without observable output/resource authority remains unresolved and does not trigger a repairable feedback item.

authority: Only observed executable operations, digest-bound resource snapshots and original source-owned checks can produce a repair candidate.
The repair pass is still single-budget and receives no whole-opportunity re-analysis request.
A repairable wiring gap is not a program failure; unvalidated actions remain explicitly unvalidated until a re-run establishes a result.
Metadata-only changes are revalidated through executeActionIds, priorReport and validation binding; independent actions remain isolated.
claimBoundary: F4 is deterministic local engineering evidence using in-process substitutes and synthetic evidence. It does not establish real model behavior, whole-skill/API correctness, readiness, human savings, prospective eligibility or held-out performance.
nextStage: F5 parameter and path variation checks
